agent_types.name: Machine
agent_types.description: A machine cycles Idle/Busy while Working; wear from each job started, or a rare random failure, sends it to Broken. Repair uses deep history so it resumes the sub-state (Idle or Busy) it was in.

info.title: Machine agent with repair
info.description: Six Machine agents, each Working{Idle, Busy} while processing jobs (EXPO(2) idle, EXPO(5) busy). Two composite-level transitions out of Working, live regardless of which child is active and not restarted by an Idle<->Busy move: a rare random breakdown (rate 0.002, MTBF ~500 min) and a usage-based preventive-maintenance condition (self.wear >= 20, incremented on each Busy entry). Either sends the machine to Broken; repair (EXPO(30)) re-enters Working with history "deep", so the machine resumes the sub-state -- Idle or Busy -- it was in when it broke down, and resets wear. KPIs: COUNT("Machines", "Working") vs COUNT("Machines", "Broken"), and fleet availability.
info.author: Naga example
